description: Mobileheroes 通訊大賽歷屆得獎作品團隊 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部產業發展署. 為使通訊產業導入創意與人才活水，經濟部工業局於2001年「無線通訊產業高峰會議」結論中指示由經濟部通訊產業發展推動小組辦理通訊大賽，並於「網路通訊產業發展推動計畫」成立「通訊大賽」項目。 其目的在於放眼未來，將校園能量導入通訊產業，鼓勵優秀學子投入產業創新研發設計工作。 有鑑於全球通訊產業發展焦點正逐漸轉型，所以自2014年起「通訊大賽」... Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部產業發展署. Its tags are 開創事業. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
